basic_info.description: Welcome to 764 Cole Street #1  a thoughtfully updated studio that perfectly balances historic charm with modern convenience. Located on a peaceful, tree-lined block in one of San Francisco's most beloved neighborhoods, this light-filled home offers the ultimate city living experience.  Step inside to find soaring ceilings, beautifully refinished hardwood floors, and tall windows that flood the space with natural light. The main living area provides both functionality and comfort, ideal for relaxing or working from home. A rare feature for a studio, the separate eat-in kitchen is spacious and fully equipped  perfect for cooking at home or entertaining friends.  The renovated bathroom features a walk-in, glass-enclosed shower with stylish tilework and an updated vanity. Additional highlights include a generous deeded storage unit just steps from your front door, shared outdoor space, and a boutique six-unit building that exudes warmth and community.  All of this is set in the heart of Cole Valley  just blocks from Zazie, Luke's Local, Golden Gate Park, and the N-Judah MUNI line. Whether you're a first-time buyer, investor, or looking for the perfect city pied--terre, this charming residence offers incredible value in a prime location!
